question: Must DeepSeek Platform session discovery use the existing browser host API with explicit user initiation, or may this provider directly inspect Chrome local storage for live authentication tokens?
rationale: This choice establishes a repository-wide security, privacy, and consent precedent that cannot be resolved from implementation correctness or test coverage alone.

options.title: Use the browser host API
options.body: Refactor session discovery through the existing explicit host/import seam and keep it user-initiated while retaining balance-only fallback behavior.

options.title: Approve direct discovery
options.body: Explicitly accept provider-specific Chrome local-storage inspection after documenting consent, prompting, token lifetime, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Defer browser enrichment
options.body: Pause or remove automatic session discovery until a repository-wide browser-session architecture is approved.

recommendation.title: Use the browser host API
recommendation.body: Refactor session discovery through the existing explicit host/import seam and keep it user-initiated while retaining balance-only fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and owner of the documented provider boundary, steipete is the strongest available decision owner for this credential-access precedent.
